subject: Botanical Formula Preserves Sleep Architecture and Restores Synaptic Proteins in Alzheimer Models
script: From Agewell Brief: Botanical Formula Preserves Sleep Architecture and Restores Synaptic Proteins in Alzheimer Models. Oral administration of Zhinao Capsules re-establishes neuron-microglia communication and clears amyloid burden in transgenic mice. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
